budget: equal NEW trial counts, model/token budgets, development seeds and evaluation schedule; not equal lifetime research effort or guaranteed GPU-hours

evaluation.limitation: existing validation cache used in earlier research; not a new untouched corpus
evaluation.reporting_access: reporting-stage terminal evaluation only, after selection.lock.json

extension: if ANY first-grid winner is at either boundary, ALL methods receive BOTH edge LRs on BOTH dev seeds; at most one extension
final_boundary: stop before reporting if ANY selected LR remains at the expanded outer boundary

gs.boundary: half neighbor weight; symmetric row-stochastic tridiagonal
gs.optimizer_input: data-only AdamW proposals; decoupled weight decay unchanged
gs.scope: Proj: all homologous private FFN and round-attention linear weights
gs.source: arXiv:2606.30813v1 Eq.2, Algorithm 1; local reimplementation, not released author code

inference: paired seeds; 95% t intervals descriptive; 97.5% two-sided intervals for two primary contrasts (Bonferroni); six complete pairs, mean<0, >=5 wins, simultaneous upper<0
initialization: paired from identical freshly constructed weights and RNG; no shared update-200 prefix
invalid_recipe: a recipe needs finite terminal DEV loss on BOTH seeds
numerical_failure: a numerically divergent trial counts as exhausted; do not replace or silently drop its seed
primary: temper_cap3 minus adamw reporting loss at update 3000
temper_cap3 minus gs_window reporting loss at update 3000
scope: comparison of the fixed published alpha=0.1 Standard-Proj GS recipe under equal LR-search budget, not all GS variants or general optimizer superiority
selection: smallest mean terminal DEV loss over both development seeds, independently per method

temper.scope: private FFN gate/up/down only; original norm-restored rule
